title: No Projectile Boosting
description: Prevents players from shooting themselves with projectiles to get boosted forwards
body:
# **No Projectile Boosting**
No Projectile Boosting is a plugin made to disabled projectile boosting (shooting yourself with a projectile e.g arrow to move forwards)
![Example message](https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1tHvfENAxi_d6YWyDsEQBE73vZZl7mv8b)
Here is a video of me projectile boosting with a bow
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/wfExXRu0i68" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## **How to install**
- Make a 1.8 Spigot server
- Place the plugin jar in the your plugins folder
- Then restart your server
## **How to configure**
After you restart your server there should be a folder named "NoBowBoosts" open that folder and edit the file "config.yml"
